place.name: Cieszyn
place.description: Cieszyn ( CHESH-in, Polish: [ˈt͡ɕɛʂɨn] ; Czech: Těšín [ˈcɛʃiːn] ; German: Teschen [ˈteːʃn̩]) is a border town in southern Poland on the east bank of the Olza River, and the administrative seat of Cieszyn County, Silesian Voivodeship. The town has about 32,000 inhabitants and lies opposite Český Těšín in the Czech Republic.
